items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Who was in the band? ... Black Rag, Careless Love, Poirinelli.

ctx.x: Can you tell me about the first records you made when you made those phonograph records? Who was in the band? There were some that they were made for okay. A Careless Love and the Black and White, let's see, was it the Black Rag or Black and White Rag?
There was one called Original Tuxedo Rag.
